name: Set Afterburner Profile
description: Switches MSI Afterburner to one of its five profiles for a game, and to another one after it.
author: stephenh678
needsAdminReason: MSI Afterburner runs as Administrator and only accepts its -Profile switch from a process that does too; without elevation Windows shows a permission prompt for each switch.
scriptArguments: the profile number for the game (1 to 5), optionally the number to switch to after it ("3 1"); a path ending in MSIAfterburner.exe overrides where it's looked for
